title: Japanese-Style Donabe Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish made with donabe and jgooey. Serve over a bed of steaming hot rice.
instructions: Rinse the donabe and heat it over medium-high heat.
Add the jgooey to the donabe and cook until lightly browned.
Add the rice to the donabe and stir to combine.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
